focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: From Scores to Decisions: Reading Classification Metrics Without Losing the Plot
utility_use_case: A research team exports paired sensor measurements to CSV and wants a reproducible first-pass summary before plotting or fitting a richer model. They select the predictor and response columns explicitly, run the command, and save the JSON alongside the dataset and analysis notes. The pair count and omitted-row count expose basic data-quality changes between exports, while r and the fitted line provide a compact description of linear association. A researcher then checks a scatterplot and investigates missingness, outliers, dependence, and nonlinear patterns instead of treating the summary as an inference or causal result.
